prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns (adoption redesign), sign-in hints (sign_in hint), home waiting info (home wait_info), and home notifications (home notification) were helpful, each producing winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
Finish screen hints (finish hint), home redesigns (home redesign), and home hints (home hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but were too low for several surprising winning layout and hint changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a grid layout to present pet details, name input, and certificate preview in a balanced grid format. (why: Adoption redesigns have shown strong positive results in previous tests, and grid layouts provide clear visual structure before completion.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Starter accessory selection step insertion: Insert a new starter accessory selection screen right before the adoption certificate step so users can customize their pet with a starter item. (why: Adding customized setup steps during adoption increases investment and completion rates during pet adoption.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop spawn chime notification toggle on waiting screen: Add an audio alert notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get an audible chime when their pet spawns. (why: Home notifications have proven effective, and users often switch windows while waiting for pet initialization (median wait time is 201s).)
3: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for friend selection screen: Switch the pet selection screen to a clean vertical list layout highlighting each pet's unique traits and animations. (why: Adoption screen redesigns have consistently been effective in driving conversions through the adoption funnel.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen insertion: Add a pet personality selection screen before photo upload where users select their pet's demeanor (playful, calm, or energetic). (why: Adding custom choices during pet creation deepens user connection and reduces abandonment during the 89-second adoption stage.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Browser authentication popup fallback hint on sign-in screen: Add a troubleshooting hint below the sign-in options explaining how to unblock sign-in popups if the screen stalls. (why: Support received reports of sign-in screens stalling or failing to open, causing drop-offs at the sign-in step.)
6: [home, wait_info] Graphics system initialization status list on waiting screen: Add a graphical preparation checklist component to the waiting screen detailing window overlay and sprite loading progress. (why: Providing detailed wait info during home waiting reduces perceived wait times (mean time 2336s) and improves completion.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud save badge incentive on sign-in screen: Display a prominent cloud save badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing automated pet backup upon sign-in. (why: Sign-in step drops 13.7% of users; highlighting automatic cloud pet backup encourages sign-in completion.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns have a strong historical record (+2.5% across 13 tests), though adoption drop-off is relatively low (7.4%).
Adding new screens or flow steps consistently hurt conversion in historical tests.
Home notifications are proven winners (+2.6%) and directly address the long 201s median wait time on the home screen.
Adoption screen redesigns consistently yield positive results (+2.5% lift across 13 tests).

Strongly supported by both support ticket reports of stalling popups and sign-in drop-off (13.7%), paired with proven sign-in hint performance.
